as t from_toml awkward-toml/awkward.toml
as j from_json awkward-toml-value/awkward-toml-value.json
equals @t $j
to_json @t
to_toml @t
as w from_toml written/written.toml
equals @t $w
to_toml @w
as r from_toml crlf/crlf.toml
to_toml @r
as c from_toml comment/comment.toml
to_toml @c
as p from_toml leap-second/leap-second.toml
to_toml @p
as m from_toml specials/specials.toml
to_json @m
to_toml @m
as a from_json awkward-json/awkward.json
to_toml @a
as n from_yaml numbers/numbers.yaml
to_toml @n
as s from_json scalar/scalar.json
to_toml @s
as l arr $s $s
to_toml @l
from_toml repeated/repeated.toml
from_toml redefined/redefined.toml
from_toml dotted-header/dotted-header.toml
from_toml array-header/array-header.toml
from_toml open/open.toml
from_toml escape/escape.toml
from_toml trailing/trailing.toml
from_toml leading-zero/leading-zero.toml
from_toml inline-lines/inline-lines.toml
from_toml date/date.toml
from_toml fraction/fraction.toml
from_toml big/big.toml
from_toml control/control.toml
